verdict.rationale: UKVI's GOV.UK pages explain founder-relevant routes in plain second-person language rather than statute text. Examples include the Innovator Founder eligibility ("set up and run an innovative business"), exact fees, "You must apply online" with separate in-country and out-of-country flows, settlement after 3 years, and processing-time guidance. A visa-finder tool also helps non-lawyers pick the right route. Missing for 10: explicit numbered step-by-step walkthroughs shown in the evidence (sequencing is only implied by the separate application flows), and independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers find the guidance easy to follow.
